I’ve listed the father as the applicant, both parents as living with the child, and the current home address wherever the form asks for an address. The preschool can use the entries under **Official use only** to complete its section.

After mdoc restores the aliases, write the child’s birth date in day, month, year order. I’ve placed the supplied phone numbers in the cell fields. If either number belongs in a work or home field, move it there by hand. Complete the `NEEDS-YOU` entries on your device.
